notes.title: Step Into the Illusion — Possessions Demo Now Live!
notes.content:
Sometimes, the way we see the world is the puzzle itself.

Possessions invites you to slow down and look again — at shapes, at shadows, at shifting perspectives. It’s a puzzle game built around quiet moments of discovery, with no words to tell you what to do, only a world that gently unfolds when you change your point of view. 

The demo, now live on Steam for Windows, macOS, and Linux as part of Steam Next Fest 2025, offers a glimpse into this meditative experience:

Twist reality and solve chaos in the first chapter of the game.

Unlock silent stories without a single line of dialogue.

Immerse yourself in a minimalist space designed for calm and curiosity.

We’ve poured our hearts into making a game that rewards patience and invites reflection. Now, we’re eager for you to play, explore, and share what you see.

notes.title: The Story Behind Possessions—Live from Comic Con x IGU
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're thrilled to share that Possessions was recently featured at Indie Game Utsav—India's largest celebration of homegrown indie games at Comic Con India!

Among 100+ titles, Possessions stood out for its unique take on spatial puzzles and perspective-based gameplay. If you’re into relaxing but clever games that challenge how you see the world, this one’s worth a closer look. Check out some of the coolest games from India in the special  Indie Game Utsav Steam Sale!

To mark the occasion, we’re sharing a special Steam broadcast featuring:

 A behind-the-scenes developer interview with Chirag Chopra (Game Director) discussing the design philosophy and evolution of Possessions.
 A live AMA session from the event covering player questions, development insights, and what’s next for the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3384920/Possessions

Thanks to everyone who visited us at Comic Con—and to those discovering the game for the first time here on Steam, welcome.
